# Flutter Leaf Network Library - LLM Documentation

This index lists Leaf Network documentation pages formatted for LLMs.
Each link points to a standalone Markdown file under the /llms path.

## HTTP

- [HTTP Overrides](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/http/http-overrides.md): Global HttpClient configuration with connection limit

## Cookie

- [Cookie Store](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/cookie/cookie-store.md): Singleton cookie persistence via SharedPreferences

## Dio

- [Client](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/dio/client.md): Dio client initialization with converters, interceptors, and service registry
- [Service](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/dio/service.md): Abstract service base and typed GET/POST/PUT/DELETE methods
- [Response](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/dio/response.md): Typed response wrapper with success check and exception access
- [Converter](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/dio/converter.md): BuiltValue JSON converter and DioException converter with interfaces
- [Interceptor](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/dio/interceptor.md): cURL logging interceptor and request header/body interceptor
- [Request Header](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/dio/request-header.md): Header builder with device OS, version, and authorization support
- [Multipart](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/dio/multipart.md): File model for multipart uploads with URI, XFile, and bytes support
